name: get_character_equipped_weapon_item_id

stack.evidence: ScriptCommand_GetCharacterEquippedWeaponItemId replaces the top character index with the byte at offset 0x36 of the corresponding 0x74-byte character record in D_003010F8

notes: Character-record offset 0x36 stores the equipped weapon item ID. func_001F0600 compares that field in character record 0 against item IDs 82 through 85; the inventory table identifies those IDs as Dream Sword, Dream Shield, Dream Rod, and Wooden Sword. The only JP call passes character index 0 in pc01.ard and stores the result in scenario byte 1300.
